long_biography.plain_text:
Norman Wisdom built a screen career around an acrobatic “little man” who confronted officious authority with a crooked cap, ill-fitting suit and meticulously timed pratfalls. Trouble in Store brought his first leading film role and a BAFTA newcomer award; a long Rank series then carried the character to audiences far beyond Britain.

His popularity proved especially durable in Albania, where the underdog figure was known as Pitkin. Wisdom later showed a different register in the television drama Going Gently and continued performing into old age. Knighted in 2000, he left a body of physical comedy whose international appeal depended as much on movement as dialogue.
